system.description:
Grants the ability to impose a penalty to a target’s offensive attribute roll.

  • Level 1: Minor penalty
  • Level 2: Moderate penalty
  • Level 3: Significant penalty
  • Level 4: -8 penalty to attacker using the specific Attribute
  • Level 5: -10 penalty to attacker using the specific Attribute
  • Level 6: -12 penalty to attacker using the specific Attribute
